description: Retrieve a current supplier and organization evidence report from official GLEIF legal-entity, USAspending prime-contract, SEC filing-activity, and OFAC Entity records, with bounded source-specific coverage for procurement research and no identity, linkage, risk, or compliance verdict.

country_code.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 filter applied only to GLEIF candidates
country_code.title: Country Code

legal_name.description: Organization legal or trading name used independently across official GLEIF, USAspending, SEC, and OFAC organization records
legal_name.title: Legal Name

sec_identifier.description: Optional SEC ticker or CIK; when absent, the exact organization name is resolved against the SEC company directory
sec_identifier.title: Sec Identifier

name: research.organization-evidence

data.description: Structured Official supplier evidence report result

next_actions.description: Optional separately priced follow-up calls. Each action requires a new payment challenge and explicit buyer authorization.

handoff_path.description: Free full contract and spend-capped command handoff; reading it does not execute or purchase the follow-up.

input_template.description: Client-side template only: $request refers to the original input, $result to this response, and $json(...) serializes its argument. The server does not execute the follow-up.
